description.value:
Sephirotic Scion. Your blood remembers the higher spheres. Light hangs around you a little too long, prayers sometimes answer themselves, and the world’s moral architecture feels less like an abstraction and more like the weather report.

Sephirotic Scion Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Sephirotic).

  • Size. You are Medium.

  • Speed. Your walking speed is 6 squares

  • attributes. Your background determines your attribute increases; Sephirotic Scion does not grant any attribute bonuses.

Your Sephirotic heritage grants you additional features through advancements (Item Grants) added during character creation: sephirotic physiology, attunement to higher patterns, holy conduction, the Light of Harmony, and strategic hooks that tilt factions toward soft power, diplomacy, and alignment work.

Bad Eden Heritage (v1.1, RFI-native). Sephirotic Scion heritage: Ophanic.

“The wheels were full of eyes. You never stop turning. You never stop seeing.”

Sephirotic Scion (Ophanic). Your blood runs rotating. The Ophanim are wheels-and-eyes — motion, sight, the order that is always already looking both ways. You are descended from a thing that could not be snuck up on because it had no back. You kept some of that. Not all. Enough.

Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Sephirotic Scion).

  • Size. Medium.

  • Movement. 6 squares walking.

  • Lineage Lean. Sephirotic Scion does not grant fixed attribute bonuses; your background handles increases. Your heritage leans toward Intrigue in fiction and through Tier powers.

Sephirotic Scion Core: The Higher Register

Shared across all Sephirotic Scion heritages. Granted at character creation via the base ancestry item.

  • Sephirotic Physiology. You have resistance to sephirotic damage. Your blood runs a little bright under the right light; you do not technically age while on consecrated ground.

  • Sefirot Attunement. At creation, pick one sephirah (player choice). Once per scene, you can invoke its register and gain a +1 rank bonus to one check that falls clearly within that sephirah's domain.

  • Holy Conduit. Manifestations, rituals, and other sephirotic-register effects that target you or pass through your space treat their effective caster-attribute as +1 for the duration of that effect. Works on allies and on you; does not work on qliphothic-register effects.

  • Light of Harmony. When two or more creatures within 6 squares of you are in active, explicit agreement (stated aloud), they each gain 1 temporary Integrity. This refreshes when a new agreement is reached between different creatures.

Ophanic Traits

  • Wheel-and-Eye. You can see invisible creatures and objects within 6 squares as dimly lit shapes. You cannot be flanked.

  • Concentric Sight. You reroll the lowest die on Mind (Perception) checks that involve noticing movement, pattern, or change over time. You roll 3d10 keep lowest 2 on Mind (Perception) checks to notice things that have been perfectly still since before you started looking — you see motion, not furniture.

Strategic Hooks (Foundry / Bad Eden)

  • OP Edge. Your faction gains +2 Intrigue OP and +1 Violence OP at campaign start.

  • Hex Synergy. In Battlefield / Procession / High-Traffic hexes, your faction's observation and counter-intel operations gain +2 on the success check.

  • Turning Witness. Once per Strategic Turn, you may observe one exchange of goods, intelligence, or personnel between two rival factions within your field of influence. You learn that it happened and between whom, though not necessarily what was exchanged.

description.value:
"The future is just memory pointed the other way."

The Dreamwalker reads the Tree and works manifestations — and that work is the fuel. You run on Surge like everyone, but yours arrives when you cast a manifestation (bank +1, max +2/round). The old sprawl folds into this: Echo Dice are now Surge, and the eight soma-break feats live on as four tier powers.

The Oracle (spent via Surge)

  • Omen (1) — you or an ally saw the thread coming: banks a reroll-lowest.
  • Dream Ward (2) — an ally drifts into a protective dreamstate: DR + a reroll.
  • Shared Dream (3) — allies within 6 squares bank a reroll and draw 1 Clarity (refuels their casting).
  • Reality Hack (5) — rewrite the moment: the party banks a reroll and one enemy rolls its next attack at disadvantage.

The Dream-Cache endures — bank a manifestation between scenes, deploy it next scene without paying Clarity. And the oracle's quiet work stays out of combat: Dream Resonance still senses a hex's Sephirah, and you still Commune with the Great Work for a true answer.

description.value:
Dream-Sense. Your dreams are not private—they are diagnostic readouts of the world's hidden structure.

  • You gain a subtle, constant awareness of emotional, moral, and metaphysical gradients in your environment.
  • You always sense Sephirothic or Qliphothic tilt in a hex you enter.
  • Your Spark sensitivity is higher than most; your dreams react to metaphysical disturbances long before waking senses do.

Lucid Step. You exist at a slight angle to normal motion. When danger arrives, you are already half-in the place you meant to go.

  • You gain +1 to Intrigue check.
  • Once per Soma Break, when you take damage you can reduce the total by an amount equal to your tier.

Initiate of the Great Work. Sleep is a meeting place, not a refuge.

  • Once per Soma Break, you may choose to reroll the lowest die on an Insight (Soul) checks, a Soul check, or a Presence check as you call upon the Dream for guidance.
  • You may ask the Dream one question each a Soma Break—an omen, a vector, or a hidden connection. The Dream does not lie, but neither is it always literal.

Oneiric Pulse. Close your eyes. The future blinks first.

  • Your consciousness intermittently echoes ahead of your physical movement, granting subtle foresight.
  • You can feel metaphysical anomalies ‘warming up’ before they manifest.

Tier 1 — Oneiric Reservoir. Your Clarity maximum is +2. On Soma Break you recover Clarity equal to your tier instead of the flat default. Detect Spark resonance in adjacent hexes (carryover).

Discipline (passive): Clarity max +2.

Skill rank +1 in Perception and Faith.

items.name: Trance of the Sapphire Gate (Bad Eden)

description.value:
"Every threshold is also a doorway."

Mode: Transitional · Drift: Sideways

The Sapphire Gate treats walls as suggestions and distance as paperwork. Your Surge spends are repositioning made real — carrying allies clear, stepping through a threshold for the tactical edge, holding the line steady at the door.

Trance (spent via Surge)

  • Gate-Touched (1) — carry an ally through to safety: DR + a freed reaction.
  • Sapphire Step (2) — you and an ally step through and out elsewhere: each banks a reroll + a freed reaction.
  • Gate Held Open (3) — allies within 6 squares bank a reroll and gain DR (the threshold steadies them).

Out-of-combat: threshold-sight, the true teleport-by-linkage, the Gate Held Open evacuation, and the Gatewright capstone (make a door where none was) remain the explorer's powers.

“You were never alone in your body.”

Archetype (Bad Eden): The Moon (Ancient Blood). You carry something older than law. Memory moves through you. It expects to matter.

Archetype Effects

  • Faction Edge. Your presence amplifies symbolism, inherited legitimacy, buried memory, and eerie cultural authority. This Archetype is associated with +1 Soft Power in faction calculus in Bad Eden’s faction calculus.
  • Tier Engine. See this Archetype’s Tier feats (Tier 1–4) for your full tactical and strategic toolkit; those are granted automatically by the Tier Engine at the appropriate character levels.

description.value:
Mercy - Expansion without fear. +1 Diplomacy, +1 Culture OPs

Chesed creates room for others to live, recover, and belong. It rewards community-building, morale recovery, and factions that grow stronger by sheltering rather than merely surviving.

Occult Association (Bad Eden): Prophet / Oracle.

“The future is not hidden. It is just expensive to hear clearly.”

Prophets do not control the future. They endure proximity to it.

Where Tarot Mages manipulate timing and probability like gamblers with dangerous discipline, Prophets stand closer to the signal itself. They hear pattern before it becomes event, consequence before it becomes story, and warning before anyone else admits there is something to warn about.

To a Prophet, the Great Work is not just about choosing well. It is about seeing the shape of what is coming early enough to alter who is prepared for it.

How Prophets pursue the Great Work:

  • By reading emerging pressure before it resolves into action
  • By recognizing encounter patterns before they fully manifest
  • By turning foresight into factional advantage
  • By making ignorance more expensive than preparation

Resonance: Keter / Signal — possibility, revelation, pattern-emergence, and the unbearable weight of glimpsing too much too early.

Tell-tales: pauses before bad news, unfinished sentences that become correct later, eyes that track causes before effects.

Faction Effect (Passive):

  • +1 to Intrigue, planning, or foresight-adjacent OP rolls (GM adjudicates the exact lane)

Cost Principle: foresight creates burden. Expect omen pressure, emotional Stress, false-positive anxiety, and resentment from people who preferred not to know what was coming.

Tier 1 (Level 1) — The Moon

  • Tactical: You learn Message and gain a skill rank in Lore.

Tier 1 — Prophet / Oracle

“You don’t know the future. You just know when something has started.”

At Tier 1, you begin catching the edge of events before they fully arrive. Not enough to command them. Enough to stop being surprised.

Tactical (Character Scale)

  • Gain a skill rank in Insight and Perception
  • 1/Soma Break, ask the GM one focused omen-question about an immediate situation, route, or known danger; the answer should be truthful but limited, symbolic, or pressure-based

Strategic (Faction Scale)

  • Once per Strategic Turn, before a planning-heavy, reconnaissance, or intrigue-forward action, gain +2 to one relevant OP roll by declaring what sign your faction is acting on

Cost: early warning is rarely comfortable. Expect unease, distraction, or tension when you sense something going wrong before anyone else can justify reacting to it.

item.lore:
A cheap, mass-produced stiletto with an apology engraved up the fuller. The engraving is competent. The steel is mediocre. The point is sharp. They were sold in bulk before the Shattering as novelty items at gas stations. After the Shattering, somebody noticed they actually work — and not just in the obvious ways.

Mercy Engraving. When you reduce a creature to 0 Integrity with this knife, the kill incurs no Blood Debt. The engraved apology counts. Reality accepts the receipt. (Mal: "Don't think about this too hard. The metaphysics are at minimum dubious. The mechanic is real.")

Edge of Control

You don’t just strike enemies. You place them.

Rules

Once per turn when you deal damage with a weapon or manifestation, choose one: push the target 1 square, pull the target 1 square, or knock the target prone if it is your size or smaller.

Step sideways, see which kind of dream waits.

Once per Strategic Turn, when your faction generates or receives a Spark Lead (a clue, ping, or emergent phenomenon pointing toward a Spark), you may spend 1 Soft Power OP to perform a Sapphire Lucidity check.

  • You immediately learn whether the next Spark is Conceptual, Vestigial, or Animate.
  • This insight cannot reveal power level, danger tier, or location—only the metaphysical class of the Spark.

This is not divination. It’s memory from the world-that-was.

description.value:
Adaptive Defense

Defense is not denial. It is management.

Rules

When you are hit by an attack you can see, you may use your reaction to reduce the damage by an amount equal to your skill rank bonus + your Violence or Intrigue value (your choice).

Some couriers walk; some dream their routes.

While you are asleep or in a dream state (magical or mundane), you may send short messages (up to 12 words) to up to tier allies who are:

  • In Hexes adjacent to your own, and
  • Marked as Gate Anchors by you at any previous time.

Allies receive these messages as sudden waking impressions or dream-echoes. They may send one brief reply (12 words) which you hear as though whispered across a hallway of light.

description.value:
Iron Will

Your mind—or your body—has learned how to say no.

Rules

Choose Soul or Body. You gain a skill rank in defense checks using that attribute. Once per Sanctuary, you may reroll a failed defense check using that attribute.

Wake bearing good news from the other side.

When you finish a a Soma Break, choose up to tier allies who rested with you.

  • They each gain temporary Integrity equal to your tier.
  • They may each remove the Shaken condition if they are suffering from it.

You return from dreams carrying a little morning light for everyone.

Threatening Silence

Sometimes the quiet is the threat.

Rules

As a Bonus action once per Respite, choose one creature that can see you within 6 squares That creature roll 3d10 keep lowest 2 on its next attack roll against a target other than you.

Let the Spark’s afterglow pass through you safely.

Once per a Soma Break, when your party completes a Spark Step—stabilization, purification, negotiation, containment, or conversion—you may invoke Sapphire Conduction.

  • Reduce an appropriate Darkness Track by 1.
  • You gain advantage on the first defense check or skill check related to Spark falloff or Spark backlash in the next 24 hours.

You ground the metaphysical heat, leaving the region a touch brighter.

description.value:
Grave Calm

Panic spreads. So does steadiness.

Rules

You reroll the lowest die on defense checks against being Shaken. If you succeed, choose one ally within 2 squares to gain the same benefit on their next save.

Scavenged Insight (Soul)

Debris tells stories.

Rules

After a combat encounter, you may ask the GM one factual question about what the enemies were carrying, guarding, or afraid of.

You walk the lucid corridor between sparks.

Once per a Soma Break, as an action, you may open the Blue Meridian for 1 minute:

  • You may teleport up to 6 squares as part of any movement or bonus action.
  • You may teleport to any Gate Anchor you have placed within 60 squares, provided the path does not cross solid barriers (doors are fine; walls are not).
  • Allies within 2 squares of a Gate Anchor you teleport to may also teleport to that Anchor as a reaction (once each per activation).
  • Whenever you teleport, you gain advantage on the next defense check you make before the end of your next turn.

Strategic Echo. If the Blue Meridian is used during a Spark Step or metaphysical crisis to reposition the party into a stabilizing or protective configuration, reduce an appropriate Darkness Track by 1.

description.value:
Calm the Mob

Crowds don’t think. They feel. So you give them something else to feel.

Rules

You gain a skill rank in Diplomacy (Presence) or Intimidation (Presence) (your choice). If you already have it, you gain mastery.

When you spend at least 1 minute addressing a group of non-hostile or uncertain creatures, you may make a Presence (Diplomacy (Presence) or Intimidation (Presence)) check (DC set by the GM). On a success, you reduce immediate hostility: the crowd hesitates, disperses, or agrees to hear terms. On a failure, you still buy time, but a complication occurs (a challenger steps forward, guards arrive, a rumor spreads).
